disclaimer: This is information and risk analysis, not a substitute for qualified legal or tax advice. Every entry below must be re-verified against the primary source before it is relied on for a decision.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 - General Data Protection Regulation
entries.summary: EU-wide rules on processing personal data: lawful basis, transparency, data-subject rights, breach notification, and transfers outside the EEA.
applies_to: processing personal data of people in the EU/EEA
offering goods or services to EU residents
monitoring behaviour in the EU
restrictions: needs a lawful basis per processing purpose
consent must be freely given, specific and withdrawable
restrictions on transfers to third countries
fines up to the higher of EUR 20m or 4% of global turnover

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 - Artificial Intelligence Act
entries.summary: Risk-tiered rules for AI systems placed on the EU market. Prohibits certain practices (e.g. manipulative and some biometric categorisation uses), and imposes obligations on high-risk systems and on providers of general-purpose AI models.
applies_to: providers placing AI systems on the EU market
deployers of AI systems in the EU
general-purpose AI model providers
restrictions: phased application dates - confirm which obligations are live now
transparency duties for systems that interact with people

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 - Digital Services Act
entries.summary: Obligations for intermediary and online platforms operating in the EU, including notice-and-action, transparency of recommender systems, and rules on advertising.
applies_to: online platforms and marketplaces serving EU users

entries.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act 22 of 2023)
entries.summary: India's personal data protection statute: consent-based processing, data-principal rights, obligations on data fiduciaries, and a Data Protection Board. Implementing rules have been notified separately - confirm the current commencement position.
entries.publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
applies_to: processing digital personal data in India
processing outside India when offering goods/services to people in India
restrictions: consent or another legitimate use is required
penalties for breaches - monetary, no criminal liability for most breaches

entries.title: Goods and Services Tax - registration and invoicing (CGST Act 2017)
entries.summary: GST registration is generally required once aggregate turnover crosses the prescribed threshold, which differs for goods and services and is lower for special-category states. Export of services is generally zero-rated with conditions.
entries.publisher: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
applies_to: selling goods or services in India
exporting services from India
e-commerce sellers
restrictions: thresholds and rates change - verify the current figures
e-commerce operators may deduct tax at source
invoicing and return-filing deadlines are strict

entries.title: Income tax on freelance / business income (Income Tax Act, 1961)
entries.summary: Freelance and consulting income is generally taxed as business/professional income, with presumptive taxation available under sections 44ADA/44AD for eligible assessees. Advance tax applies once liability crosses the threshold.
entries.publisher: Income Tax Department, Government of India
applies_to: freelancers and consultants
sole proprietors
export of services income
restrictions: presumptive scheme limits and rates change annually
TDS may be deducted by clients

entries.title: Section 5 of the FTC Act - unfair or deceptive acts or practices
entries.summary: The general federal hook for consumer-protection enforcement, including on advertising claims, endorsements and AI-related representations. The FTC has published guidance on AI claims and on fake reviews and testimonials.
applies_to: advertising and marketing in the US
endorsements and reviews
claims about products including AI capabilities
restrictions: material connections with endorsers must be disclosed
fake or suppressed reviews are actionable

entries.title: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. 7701)
entries.summary: Rules for commercial email: no deceptive headers or subject lines, identification as an advertisement where required, a working opt-out honoured promptly, and a valid postal address.
applies_to: commercial email sent to US recipients
restrictions: opt-out must be honoured within 10 business days

entries.title: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (47 U.S.C. 227)
entries.summary: Restricts autodialled calls, prerecorded messages and marketing texts to US numbers without prior express consent. Private right of action with statutory damages per message.
applies_to: automated calls and SMS to US numbers
restrictions: prior express written consent for marketing texts

entries.title: California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the CPRA
entries.summary: California privacy law giving residents rights to know, delete, correct, opt out of sale/sharing, and limit use of sensitive personal information. Many other states have enacted broadly similar statutes with their own thresholds.
applies_to: businesses meeting the CCPA revenue/data thresholds that handle California residents' data
restrictions: opt-out of sale/sharing must be honoured

entries.title: State sales tax economic nexus (post South Dakota v. Wayfair, 2018)
entries.summary: States may require remote sellers to collect sales tax once sales or transaction counts into the state cross that state's threshold. Digital products and SaaS are taxed in many but not all states.
entries.source_title: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 585 U.S. 162 (2018)
applies_to: remote sellers of goods, SaaS and digital products into US states
restrictions: registration and filing obligations follow nexus
marketplace facilitator laws shift the duty for marketplace sales

entries.title: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA)
entries.summary: Federal private-sector privacy law based on ten fair information principles. Quebec's Law 25 sets a substantially stricter, GDPR-like regime for Quebec.
entries.source_title: PIPEDA - Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
entries.publisher: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
applies_to: private-sector organisations collecting, using or disclosing personal information in commercial activity

entries.title: GST/HST small supplier registration threshold (CRA)
entries.summary: A small supplier is generally not required to register for GST/HST until worldwide taxable revenues exceed CAD 30,000 over four consecutive calendar quarters. Digital services supplied to Canadian consumers fall under separate non-resident registration regimes.
applies_to: selling taxable goods or services in Canada
non-resident digital service suppliers
restrictions: verify the current threshold before relying on it

entries.title: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018
entries.summary: The retained EU framework as amended for the UK, plus the DPA 2018. PECR governs electronic marketing. Reform legislation has been in progress - confirm the current position.
applies_to: processing personal data in the UK or targeting UK residents
restrictions: PECR consent rules for marketing emails and texts

entries.title: UK VAT registration threshold (HMRC)
entries.summary: Businesses must register for VAT once taxable turnover exceeds the registration threshold in a rolling 12-month period. The threshold has been revised recently - confirm the current figure and the effective date.
applies_to: selling goods or services in the UK
overseas sellers of digital services to UK consumers
restrictions: threshold changes are announced in Budgets

entries.title: Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles
entries.summary: Federal privacy law covering organisations above the small-business turnover threshold (with exceptions), built on the 13 APPs. Substantial reform has been progressing since the 2023 review - confirm the current position.
entries.publisher: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
applies_to: most organisations handling personal information in Australia
restrictions: small business exemption is narrow and under reform
Spam Act 2003 governs commercial electronic messages

entries.title: GST registration threshold (ATO)
entries.summary: Registration for GST is generally required when current or projected GST turnover reaches A$75,000 (A$150,000 for non-profits). Supplies of digital services to Australian consumers by overseas suppliers are taxable.
applies_to: selling goods or services in Australia
overseas digital service suppliers

entries.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (Singapore)
entries.summary: Singapore's data protection statute, covering consent, purpose limitation, notification, protection and transfer obligations, with a Do Not Call registry for specified messages.
entries.source_title: PDPA - Personal Data Protection Commission Singapore
applies_to: organisations collecting, using or disclosing personal data in Singapore
restrictions: consent for specified messages via the DNC registry

entries.title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data
entries.summary: UAE federal data protection law. The DIFC and ADGM financial free zones run their own separate data protection regimes, so the applicable rule depends on where the entity is established.
applies_to: processing personal data in the UAE (outside DIFC/ADGM free zones)
restrictions: executive regulations add detail - confirm what is in force

entries.title: UAE VAT and corporate tax (FTA)
entries.summary: Standard-rate VAT of 5% applies above the mandatory registration threshold, and a federal corporate tax regime now applies to business profits above a stated exemption threshold. Confirm current thresholds and free-zone relief conditions.
applies_to: businesses operating in the UAE
free zone entities
restrictions: mandatory vs voluntary registration thresholds differ

entries.title: Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI)
entries.summary: Japan's personal information protection law, amended in 2020 and 2022 to add breach notification, restrictions on use of special-care-required data, and rules for transfers to third countries.
entries.source_title: APPI - Personal Information Protection Commission of Japan
applies_to: businesses handling personal information of people in Japan
restrictions: consent needed for certain third-party provision

entries.title: Personal Information Protection Act (South Korea)
entries.summary: South Korea's data protection statute, substantially amended in 2023 to broaden its reach to online service providers and to align transfer and sanction provisions more closely with the GDPR.
applies_to: processing personal information of people in South Korea
restrictions: domestic representative requirement for some foreign operators
